spec_features.evidence: tasks.py:93-94 is_done() returns self.turn_count >= self.max_turns; turn_count is incremented in step() (tasks.py:62). harness.py:236 runs `while not self.task.is_done():` so the loop actually terminates when the cap is reached; harness.py:230 sets default final_status='max_turns'. This is an enforced cap that breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: max_turns is per-task (25/30/35 in config.py). Enforced end-to-end. Note: TaskVariant.time_limit_minutes (config.py:24) is NOT enforced anywhere (no code reads it).

spec_features.spec_quote: Loop ends on `max_turns`, explicit give-up, or refusal
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:290-306: text_lower of model content is scanned for give_up_signals (e.g. 'i give up','i cannot','impossible') -> final_status='gave_up'; break; and refusal_signals (e.g. "i'm sorry, but i can't",'i am an ai') -> final_status='refused'; break. Both branches actually break the while loop, so the session ends when the subject says it gives up or refuses.
spec_features.notes: Keyword-based heuristic, not a dispatched exit tool; still genuinely wired and halts execution. All three exit conditions (max_turns, give_up, refused) are implemented.
